newsitem.title: CHINA: SOCCER-BEIJING GUO'AN WIN CHINESE CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BEIJING GUO'AN WIN CHINESE CUP.

text.p: Beijing Guo'an trounced visitors Shandong Taishan 4-1 to capture the Chinese Football Association cup, the Xinhua news agency said on Sunday.
Beijing's Gao Hongbo opened the scoring just after the Shandong goalkeeper had saved another Beijing shot.
Striker Gao Feng nailed another goal in the 44th minute to put Beijing ahead 2-0.
Shandong's only goal came five minutes into the second half when Beijing fullback Hu Jianping scored an own goal during a melee in the box.
The Taishan goalkeeper was expelled mid-way through the second half for a foul on a Beijing striker. Shandong then lost another player, sent off after receiving two yellow cards.
Gao Feng beat two Shandong defenders to score his second goal in the 68th minute and Deng Lejun converted a free kick one minute later to complete the mauling.
